hero.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
hero.description: A passionate software developer focused on React.js and Spring Boot, building user-friendly web applications and scalable backend services.

about.label: About
about.title: Who am I and what do I do?
about.p1: I'm a Computer Engineering graduate from Karabük University. Alongside my undergraduate studies, I participated in an exchange program at Vilnius Gediminas Technical University in Lithuania.
about.p2: I gained hands-on full-stack development experience through internships and TÜBİTAK-supported projects. With a strong focus on React.js and Spring Boot, I build user-friendly web applications and RESTful APIs.
about.p3: I'm motivated to grow and contribute as a Junior Full-Stack Developer in product-focused teams.

items: Developed responsive user interfaces using React.js, Redux, and Redux Toolkit.
Built reusable UI components and contributed to a shared design system.
Worked in agile sprints and collaborated with frontend team members.
Contributed to a blockchain-integrated web application.
Worked on a crypto payment system using Firebase.

items.name: Birik
items.description: A personal budget and expense tracking application. A web app that allows users to manage income/expenses, filter by categories, and visualize their financial data.

items.name: LstmCryptoBot
items.description: An AI-based cryptocurrency trading bot built with Python and LSTM neural networks. Time-series analysis was performed on Bitcoin price data, models trained with TensorFlow/Keras, backtested with Backtrader, and containerized with Docker.

items.name: Kadın Emeği
items.description: A TÜBİTAK-supported second-hand marketplace application. Backend services built with Spring Boot and frontend features developed with React.js.

items.name: Tribün
items.description: A football prediction league app where users climb the leaderboard by predicting match results. Frontend built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4; backend powered by Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
